desc: Derive and prove the minimal-operations formula for a subarray and the monotonicity properties needed for sliding-window counting.
Implement the next-greater binary-lifting approach with a cost query and two-pointer counting over right endpoints.
Handle equal values correctly in the next-greater chain and prefix-maximum segment cost calculations.
Handle large sums safely and ensure the algorithm runs in near-linear or O(n log n) time for n = 10^5.
Run sample tests and random brute-force validation, including edge cases; fix any failures.
